document_evidence.evidence_summary: Neither party may assign without the prior written consent of the other party; a Change of Control of Supplier constitutes an assignment for this section.
If a Change of Control completes without Customer's prior written consent, Customer may terminate on ninety days' written notice within 180 days of awareness.
Sustained failure to meet the 99.5% availability target in any three consecutive months entitles Customer to a service credit of up to 8% of the Annual Subscription Fee.
Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve month periods unless either party gives at least sixty days' written notice of non-renewal.
Customer's 18% discount shall remain not less favourable than the effective discount granted to any other customer of comparable annual committed spend.
If a more favourable discount is granted to a comparable customer, Supplier must notify Customer within 30 days, apply it retrospectively, and issue a credit note.
Availability target is 99.5% measured monthly; where availability falls below 99.0% in any two consecutive months, Customer may terminate for material breach on 30 days' notice.
Where Severity 1 incidents exceed four in any rolling three month period, the matter shall be escalated and Customer's remedies under Section 12.2 shall be available.
Agreement may be assigned by either party to a successor in interest without consent, provided the assignee assumes all obligations in writing.
Automatic renewal for successive twelve month periods, sixty days' notice of non-renewal.
Supplier grants a discount of thirty-four per cent (34%) against list pricing for the duration of the Initial Term.
Fees shall increase annually on each anniversary by the lesser of CPI-U change and three per cent (3%).
Assignable to a successor in interest without consent.
Six years from 1 January 2024, expiring 31 December 2029.

Territory means the member states of the European Union, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, and Norway.

sql_evidence.query: SELECT claim_id, claim_text, metric_key, claimed_value, period, cim_page FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_claim ORDER BY claim_id

sql_evidence.query: SELECT c.contract_id, c.customer_id, cu.customer_name, c.contract_start_date, c.contract_end_date, c.contract_type, c.auto_renew_flag, c.notice_period_days, c.discount_pct, c.status, c.source_doc_ref FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract c LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer cu ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id WHERE c.contract_id IN ('CTR-00001','CTR-00002','CTR-00003','CTR-00004','CTR-00006') ORDER BY c.contract_id
sql_evidence.methodology: Validated contract-to-customer mappings and structured metadata for the reviewed authoritative agreements using discovered join key customer_id.
